title: Bob Beckwith, Philadelphia Experiment and teleportation

tellings.quote: Yes. Does he say cuz he claims that I think he was maybe somewhat involved in the Philadelphia experiment and then he later did some really interesting work with like extremely high magnetic fields and and then and teleportation.

plain: An engineer named Robert Beckwith is said to have been somewhat involved in the Philadelphia Experiment, a rumoured US Navy experiment of the 1940s, and later to have done work with extremely strong magnetic fields and with teleportation. Michels raises this himself, hedging that he only thinks this is what Beckwith claims, while talking with a guest named Dave Rossi. If true, it would mean secret wartime research went on into moving matter in exotic ways.
